manifest.name: dsh-docchain
manifest.description: DSH knowledge base and document conversion plugin: filename/content/metadata search, locate-by-doc_id/name with content reading, topic listing, bulk document upload, document-to-Markdown conversion, image-similarity search, per-document image descriptions written to a sidecar markdown, a deep-research workflow, and a knowledge-graph (Neo4j) layer — ontology inspection, read-only Cypher, and node/relation writes all go through the DocChain API (no Neo4j password needed). Every script-backed capability also ships as a native tool executed in-process; the configuration page keeps switchable docchain environments with per-environment topic selection

bundle.title: DocChain 文档与知识图谱
bundle.description: DocChain 文档检索/上传/转换/图片描述与深度研究，以及知识图谱：查本体结构、执行 Cypher、写操作，全部走 DocChain API（无需 Neo4j 密码）。

bundle.text:
# dsh-docchain bundle patch: inserts the bundled skill provider plugin.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-docchain
      name: "dsh-docchain"
      config:
        # 视觉模型候选，按综合能力从高到低。第一个可用的当主模型兜底，
        # 复核模型取其中第一个「可用且与主模型不同」的。
        # 顺序来自实测横评（5 模型 × 6 张真实组织架构图 × 每张 2 次）：
        #   doubao 两个 6/6 全对；qwen 两排平级图 0 分；glm 会把简单扇出误判成描述。
        # 本机想覆盖：在本 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里再写一次即可。
        docchain_vision_candidates: doubao-seed-2.0-pro,g-doubao-seed-2.1-pro,qwen3-vl-plus,glm-5v-turbo,g-gpt-5.6-sol

readme.text: A DSH knowledge base and document conversion plugin bundling filename/content/metadata search, topic listing, bulk document upload, document-to-Markdown conversion, a multi-subagent deep-research workflow, and a knowledge-graph (Neo4j) layer — ontology inspection, read-only Cypher, and node/relation writes all go through the DocChain API (no Neo4j password needed): install once with `plugin_manager install_bundle` and it works on any machine — no manual copying into `~/.agents/skills` required. Built on docchain.

Its configuration page goes beyond a single endpoint: it keeps a list of **saved environments** — each with its own address and its own credential — switches between them in one click, and pre-selects **topics** per environment, so a later request can say "search this topic" without naming an id.

Apart from `deep-research-advanced` (a pure instruction workflow with no script), every capability is also exposed as a **native tool**, executed in-process by the host instead of by shelling out to a script:

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `docchain_doc_search` | Locate documents by doc_id / document-name keyword, list details, optionally read content (paged, resumable) |
| `docchain_content_search` | Search document content by keyword; returns matching line numbers and content |
| `docchain_filename_search` | Find documents whose filename matches keywords, within the given topics |
| `docchain_topic_info` | List topics with pagination and a name-or-id keyword filter |
| `docchain_meta_search` | Filter documents by custom metadata fields (string/number/time, AND / OR groups) |
| `docchain_upload` | Upload a file, or a folder's top-level files, to a topic |
| `docchain_image_search` | Image-to-image search with a local picture |
| `docchain_image_describe` | Turn a document's images into text: describe each image and save a sidecar description markdown |
| `doc2markdown` | Convert docx/doc/pdf/pptx/xlsx/images and more to Markdown |
| `docchain_kg_schema` | Inspect a topic's ontology (entity types with attributes + relationship types), via the DocChain API |
| `docchain_kg_cypher` | Run a read-only Cypher query on a topic's graph, via the DocChain API |
| `docchain_kg_upsert_node` |

| Skill | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `docchain-filename-search` | SKILL.md + Node.js script | Find documents whose filename matches keywords, within the given topics (tool: `docchain_filename_search`) |
| `docchain-doc-search` | SKILL.md + Node.js script | Locate documents by doc_id or document-name keyword, show their details, and optionally read a document's content (paged, resumable; tool: `docchain_doc_search`) |
| `docchain-content-search` | SKILL.md + Node.js script | Search document content by keyword; returns line numbers and content; `or`/`and` operators (tool: `docchain_content_search`) |
| `docchain-meta-search` | SKILL.md + Node.js script | Query documents by custom metadata fields (string/number/time, exact and range; tool: `docchain_meta_search`) |
| `docchain-topic-info` | SKILL.md + Node.js script | List docchain topics with pagination and a name-or-id keyword filter (tool: `docchain_topic_info`) |
| `docchain-upload` | SKILL.md + Node.js script | Upload a local file or a whole folder to a given docchain topic in bulk (tool: `docchain_upload`) |
| `doc2markdown` | SKILL.md + Node.js script | Convert docx/doc/pdf/pptx/xlsx/images and many more formats to Ma

The same package installs into either profile — pick the one that matches how you run DSH:

| How you run DSH | Command |
|---|---|
| Desktop app | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wct-lab/dsh-docchain` |
| `dsh web` | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:wct-lab/dsh-docchain` |

Restart DSH afterwards so the host and client halves reload. Or, from a local checkout:

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target=<absolute path to this directory>
```

No credentials ship in this package. Every script except `doc2markdown` (Node.js) needs a docchain service endpoint and an API key before it can run; `doc2markdown` (Node.js) works with neither — it falls back to the built-in default endpoint and uploads anonymously, while the same config chain can point it at a custom endpoint/key.

| Field | Meaning | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `docchain_url` | docchain service address, e.g. `http://<host>:7100/llmdoc` | Yes |
| `docchain_api_key` | API authentication key | Yes |

Four ways to provide them, in **priority order** (higher wins):

Environment variables outrank everything below them, including the environment selected on the plugin's configuration page — see [Switching between environments](#switching-between-environments).

Config file format (all JSON-based):

```json
{
  "docchain_url": "http://<host>:7100/llmdoc",
  "docchain_api_key": "your-api-key-here"
}

All scripts need only Node.js. Invoke them from the skill's base directory as `node scripts/<script>.js …` (see each SKILL.md for parameters).

The plugin ships a **configuration page** in the web client: in `dsh web`, open **Plugins** in the sidebar, find the `dsh-docchain` plugin, and use the configure control on its row. The page manages a list of environments; an address and a key are properties of an environment, so they are entered and edited inside its row — there are no separate top-level fields. The key itself goes to the credential store and is write-only: the page never echoes a stored value, only whether one is set.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `docchain_url` | Service endpoint used when no environment is active; volatile, kept in sync with the active environment by the page |
| `docchain_api_key_ref` | Credential reference name for the key; default `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY` |
| `docchain_api_key` | Fallback literal key (not recommended; the store wins over it) |
| `docchain_environments` | Saved environments (JSON): per entry a name, URL, credential reference and its pre-selected topics; the active entry outranks `docchain_url` |
| `neo4j_uri` | Neo4j Bolt endpoint, e.g. `neo4j://<host>:17687`; kept for future direct graph tools (currently unused) |
| `neo4j_user` | Neo4j username, default `neo4j` |
| `neo4j_password` | Neo4j password; kept for future direct graph tools (all graph tools currently use the API) |
| `neo4j_database` | Neo4j database name, default `neo4j` |

The key's value lives in the **credential store** `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (`refs:` section, owner-only permissions) — save it through the configuration page or edit the file directly; changes hot-reload. It can also come from the launch environment under the same variable name. On activation, whenever a stored credential changes, and whenever this row's settings are saved, the resolved values are mirrored into `~/.dsh/storages/docchain-config.json` (permissions `0600`): the file is a pure projection of the current resolution, so a cleared config entry disappears from it; the scripts read it on every run.

Key resolution order: credential store (launch env > stored file) > `docchain_api_key` row literal.

The reference name *is* configuration: **leaving `docchain_api_key_ref` unconfigured is a supported state, not a broken one.** The page reports no key and the scripts exit with a configuration error instead of falling back to another reference — a present-but-wrong key queries the wrong account silently, which is far harder to notice than a failure.

To change values, either:

- use the **configuration page** on the Plugins page — add or edit an environment, including its address and key, or
- save/update `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY` in the credential store — takes effect without touching this plugin, or
- edit `~/.dsh/storages/docchain-config.json` directly (takes effect on the next script run; the plugin rewrites it from the resolved config on activation and config changes — for durable overrides use env vars or a per-skill config.json), or
- set `docchain_url` / `docchain_api_key_ref` / `docchain_api_key` in the plugin's config row (patch `config` / preset override) and re-activate the plugin.
The configuration page keeps a list of **saved environments**, so pointing the skills at another docchain service no longer means retyping a URL and a key.

- The page shows one row with the environment currently in force. Open it to see the list: pick another, add one, or edit / delete an entry.
- Picking an entry takes effect immediately — no Save press, no restart.
- Each environment stores its own URL and its own credential reference, so switching back never asks for the key again. Keys stay in the credential store and are only ever written, never read back.
- The page manages environments only: an address and a key are properties of an environment, edited inside its row — there is no separate pair of fields to keep in sync. With nothing saved the row reads "no environment selected", and the legacy `docchain_url` / `docchain_api_key_ref` values remain the fallback (editable in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`).
- Deleting an entry also deletes its credential — unless another environment still uses the same reference, or it is the row's own fallback reference. The entry in force cannot be deleted; switch away first.

Where the data lives:

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| The environment list (name, URL, credential reference, selected topics) | `config.docchain_environments` in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` |
| Each environment's key | `refs:` in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, under `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY__<ID>` |
| The values in force — URL, key, and the active environment's topics as `docchain_topic_ids` / `docchain_topic_names` | `~/.dsh/storages/docchain-config.json`, rewritten on every switch |

Two limits worth knowing:

- **An environment variable wins.** Every skill script reads `DOCCHAIN_URL` / `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY` before the projection file, so a value exported at launch silently outranks whatever the page selects. Do not set them if you want the page to be authoritative.
- Two browser tabs editing the same row: the last save wins.
Each environment can also pre-select up to **10 topics**, so a later request can say "search this topic" without naming an ID.

- The topic list comes from the active environment: one keyword box that the service matches against **both the topic id and the name** (substring, case-insensitive — a full id or a full name narrows it to one row), plus paging. Each row shows the `topic_id` and the name.
- The browser never holds the API key, so the page asks the host's same-origin route `GET /plugin/dsh-docchain/topics` and the host queries the service on its behalf.
- Selections are stored per environment (`topics` inside its entry), so switching environments switches the topic set with it.
- While at least one topic is selected, the host injects the active environment and those `topic_id`s into the agent's prompt. The agent then uses them when the user says "the current topic" or omits `topic_ids`; with nothing selected nothing is injected.
- The service URL must be the API base, not a browser landing page: a `/login?redirect=…` address makes the list fail. Such an environment is marked with ⚠ in the list.

Two limits: a topic deleted on the server stays in the selection (it is a name snapshot, and using it later will fail), and the route is reachable by any local process that can open the port — it reads the active environment's topic names and never returns a credential.
The bundle inserts one Host plugin (`dsh-docchain`). At activation it registers a skill provider on `ctx.skills` that serves every `<skills>/<name>/SKILL.md` directory in this package:

- Catalog entries come from each SKILL.md frontmatter (`name`, `description`); bodies are re-read on every load.
- The provider rank is **450** — project roots (`.dsh/skills` = 100, project `.agents/skills` = 200), runtime registrations (250) and `customSkillDirs` (300) keep precedence, as does `~/.dsh/skills` (400); the bundle outranks `~/.agents/skills` (500) and the bundled root (600). In practice: same-name copies in `~/.agents/skills` are shadowed by this bundle; delete them there if you want a single source.
- Two optional services carry the configuration page: the host registers `GET /plugin/dsh-docchain/topics` on the web server (the browser never holds the API key, so the host queries the active environment on its behalf), and a prompt section that describes the active environment and its selected topics. A profile without those services still gets the skill provider and the projection file.
- Neither the topic route nor the prompt section caches state of its own: both read the live row config on every call, so switching an environment or a topic reaches the scripts and the next model step without a restart.
Every script-backed capability is registered as a DSH tool, so the model calls it directly and the host executes it in-process — no shell step.

| Tool | Key arguments |
|---|---|
| `docchain_doc_search` | `doc_ids` or `keyword` (exactly one); `content: true` reads content (single id only); `offset` / `max_lines` page through it |
| `docchain_content_search` | `keywords` required; at least one of `doc_ids` / `topic_ids`; `operator` is `or` or `and` |
| `docchain_filename_search` | `keywords` and `topic_ids` both required (filename search inside those topics only) |
| `docchain_topic_info` | `page` / `size` / `keyword`, all optional |
| `docchain_meta_search` | `conditions` as `[{field, op, value}]` (AND), `or_groups` (OR inside, AND across); `list_fields: true` lists fields |
| `docchain_upload` | `path` + `topic_id` required; `mode` is `file` or `folder` (top level only) |
| `docchain_image_search` | `image` required; omitted `topic_ids` falls back to the page's selected topics; `all` scans everything |
| `docchain_image_describe` | `doc_ids` processes directly; `keyword` alone returns **candidates only**; `read` returns an already-generated description md; `list_models` lists usable vision models; batches of >1 need `confirm` |
| `doc2markdown` | `file_path` required; `action` is `convert` or `check`; `md_only` exports a

Tools and scripts share **one implementation**: the host requires the script modules and calls their exported compute functions, so a tool result cannot drift from a `node scripts/...` run. Registration goes through `ctx.inject(["tools"])`, so a host without the tool registry keeps the skills, the projection file and the configuration page — it just has no tools.

Failures return `{ ok: false, error, message }` with the same `error` values as the scripts: `CONFIG` / `NO_RESULTS` / `NOT_FOUND` / `NO_PERMISSION` / `SERVER_ERROR`. `doc2markdown` adds `PENDING` for "still converting, call `check` later". Arguments are arrays or objects (`doc_ids: [1, 2]`), never comma-joined strings.

`docchain_upload`, `docchain_image_describe` and the `convert` action of `doc2markdown` are marked non-concurrency-safe (one writes to the knowledge base, one is a long job, the other is a long pipeline); the search tools may run in parallel.

readme.section: docchain-filename-search — find documents by filename within given topics
readme.text:
Locate documents by filename keywords **within the specified topics**.

**How to use it** — describe the filename keywords you are looking for. You **must** specify the topic ID(s); this skill searches only inside those topics.

> Division of labour with `docchain-doc-search`: to search filenames **across all topics**, or to locate by doc_id or read a document's content, use `docchain-doc-search`. This skill is "scoped to topics + filename only".

**Examples:**

readme.section: docchain-filename-search — find documents by filename within given topics
readme.text:
- "Find documents whose filename contains 'contract' in topic 112"
- "Search for documents with 'purchase' or 'agreement' in topics 1 and 10"

readme.section: docchain-doc-search — locate by doc_id / document name and read content
readme.text: Find out "which document is this" by doc_id or by a document-name keyword, and list its details (name, topic, pages, size, state). When needed, read a document's content in pages (resume with `next_offset`). Use it for "what document is id X", "which documents have a name containing XX", or "read me the content of a document".

readme.section: docchain-doc-search — locate by doc_id / document name and read content
readme.text: **How to use it** — give one or more document IDs, or a document-name keyword (`--keyword` searches filenames across all topics); to read content, pass a single document ID with `--content`.

readme.section: docchain-doc-search — locate by doc_id / document name and read content
readme.text:
> Unlike `docchain-filename-search`, this searches filenames across all topics and can resolve by doc_id or read content; to look up a filename only within a specific topic, use `docchain-filename-search`. Unlike `docchain-content-search`, this locates the document itself by id / name rather than grepping keywords inside its content.

**Examples:**

readme.section: docchain-doc-search — locate by doc_id / document name and read content
readme.text:
- "What is document 125672?"
- "What are documents 125672 and 125755?"
- "Find documents whose name contains 'evaluation standard'"
- "Read the beginning of document 125755"

Search keywords inside document content; returns the matching line numbers and content. Supports `or` and `and` operators.

**How to use it** — specify the search scope and keywords. You must provide at least one of `doc_ids` or `topic_ids`.

**Examples:**

- "Search for 'contract' in document 123"
- "Search for content containing both 'API' and 'interface' in topics 1 and 2"

Filter documents by custom metadata field conditions — string, number, and time types with exact and range operators.

**How to use it** — describe the filter conditions. You must specify topic ID(s) or document ID(s).

**Examples:**

- "Find documents in topic 112 whose metadata author is Zhang San"
- "Find contracts in topic 113 whose amount field is greater than 1000"

Lists the topics in a docchain system with pagination, optionally filtered by a name keyword. Often a first step before other skills: get the topic IDs, then search or upload within a topic.

**How to use it** — just ask what topics exist; optionally give a page number, page size, or a name keyword.

**Examples:**

- "What topics are there?"
- "Show page 2 of the topic list, 10 per page"
- "Find topics whose name contains 'test'"

Uploads a single local file or a whole folder to a given docchain topic, one file at a time, with progress and success/failure counts. Folder scans cover top-level files only (non-recursive).

**How to use it** — provide the file/folder path and the target topic ID (`--topic_id` is required).

**Examples:**

- "Upload ./report.pdf to topic 123"
- "Bulk-upload the documents in ./docs to topic 456"

Uploads a document (docx, doc, pdf, ppt, xlsx, images, epub, mobi and many more) to the docchain parsing service and downloads the converted Markdown next to the source file — either a single `.md` file (`--md`) or a package with images and tables.

**How to use it** — point it at a file path, e.g. "read the content of ./report.pdf" or "convert 合同.docx to Markdown".

**Examples:**

- "Summarize the content of /path/to/report.pdf"
- "Convert 合同.docx to a single Markdown file"

The service URL and API key follow the same config chain as the search scripts, but both are optional: without configuration the built-in default (`https://lab.hjcloud.com/llmdoc`) is used with anonymous upload.

Uploads one local image to the active environment and returns similar pictures found in the documents — **the pictures themselves**, plus their topic (id and name), document name and similarity score. Matched images are downloaded to a temp directory so they can be shown in the conversation.

**How to use it** — attach a photo or screenshot and ask. The docchain API has no global image search, so the search is scoped to topics: by default the topics selected on the configuration page, or `--topic_ids` for others, or `--all` to walk every topic.

- "Which document is this screenshot from?"
- "Find images like this one"

Things worth knowing:

- `score` is the service's **visual similarity** (0–1; an identical image scores 1), not the assistant's judgement. Read it as a ranking, not an absolute verdict — a low score does not by itself mean "unrelated".
- Availability is **per topic**: image vectors are built one topic at a time, so a topic that was never vectorized answers every query with an empty list (observed: on the same instance, topics with vectors match and topics without return nothing). The script says so instead of pretending the library has nothing.
- A few images make the service answer HTTP 500 (that picture cannot be processed); the script reports it per topic instead of failing silently.
- `--all` walks every topic — slow and request-heavy (thousands of queries). Prefer the selected topics when you know them.

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text: Reads the document's main markdown, hands each image to a multimodal model, inserts `<!-- image-desc: … -->` directly above every image, and saves the result as that document's **sidecar description markdown**.

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text: **Flowcharts and architecture diagrams take a different route**: the model answers with a node/edge graph, and the script renders it as a `plantuml` sketch block placed where the description would be. The model never writes PlantUML itself — syntax is generated by the script, so the block is always valid — while photos, screenshots, line charts and tables keep the Chinese description.

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text:
**The main markdown is never touched**: descriptions live in a separate file, read back with `GET /v1/doc/read?doc_id=<id>&read_format=image_description_md`. Normal reading behaviour is therefore unchanged, and a chat agent reads the sidecar only when it needs the picture semantics.

**How to use it**:

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text:
- "Turn every image in 125755 into text"
- "Find documents named like…, I'll pick one" (`keyword` alone returns **candidates only** and processes nothing)
- "Is 125755's description ready?" (`read: true`)
- "Which vision models can this machine use?" (`list_models: true`)

Things worth knowing:

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text:
- **Time**: descriptions target information density (avg ~350–400 characters), so one image takes ~8–12 s. A structure image costs **3 calls** (classify + read + judge) and takes ~25–50 s; a description image costs **2** (classify + describe). Nine images measured 1–4 minutes (the gateway varies a lot). A document is processed in one pass by default; `max_images` is only for capping cost — it cannot tell you whether the descriptions are any good, and splitting the work in two makes the user pick a vision model twice.
- **Classify first**: every image is first asked one question — structure or description — and is only allowed to answer a single word. The criterion is whether the **connector lines** carry the information: lines present and removing them loses the relationships → structure; layout infographics that rely on colour blocks / columns / side labels, or parallel lists whose boxes are not connected → description (even when there are many boxes). `diagram.structured` / `diagram.as_prose` report the two counts, `diagram.suspect` counts images classified as description that answered with graph data and were re-asked once, and `diagram.annotation_guard` counts images classified

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text: **Vision model configuration**: the image-description model **follows the model you pick in the chat**, and the tool has no `model` argument — nothing can silently substitute one. If your chat model cannot read images, the tool pauses and asks you to pick a vision model from the gateway list; that pick applies to **this call only** and never changes your chat model. The fields below are the fallback used when no chat model can be resolved. Defaults to `https://lab.iwhalecloud.com/gpt-proxy/v1`, keyed by the `IWHALE_API_KEY` credential. To change endpoint or length cap, edit these fields (the configuration page does not render inputs for them):

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text:
```yaml
docchain_vision_url: https://lab.iwhalecloud.com/gpt-proxy/v1
docchain_vision_model: doubao-seed-2.0-pro         # fallback only: used when no chat model resolves
docchain_vision_candidates: doubao-seed-2.0-pro,g-doubao-seed-2.1-pro,qwen3-vl-plus,glm-5v-turbo,g-gpt-5.6-sol
                                                  # comma-separated, best first. Order comes from a measured

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text:
The CLI uses `VISION_BASE_URL` / `VISION_MODEL` / `VISION_JUDGE_MODEL` / `VISION_FALLBACK_MODEL` / `VISION_API_KEY` / `VISION_MAX_DESC_CHARS` / `VISION_DIAGRAM` instead. Use `list_models` to see which vision models your key can actually reach.

**Bring your own model service**: point `docchain_vision_url` + `docchain_vision_key_ref` at your own OpenAI-compatible gateway (Volcengine Ark, Alibaba Bailian, self-hosted vLLM all work). The model list **adapts to your gateway**:

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text:
- If the gateway returns an `is_vision` field, that field is authoritative.
- If it does not (Davinci/Doubao official, Alibaba, and OpenAI `/v1/models` only return ids), models are recognised by name (`vision`, `vl`, `gpt-4o`, `doubao-2.x`, …).
- When **none** of the built-in candidate names exist on your gateway, the list follows your gateway's own order instead of offering models you cannot call.

readme.section: docchain-image-describe — turn a document's images into text
readme.text:
**When no vision model is reachable** (for example a DeepSeek account, which only has text models), the tool does **not** open a picker; it fails fast with:

> 当前没有可使用的视觉模型，请更换 API key 选择可使用的视觉模型。

That avoids making the user pick something that cannot work.

A ReAct orchestrator-style deep-research workflow (pure instructions, no scripts): the main agent probes the topic, splits independent sub-tasks and dispatches them to parallel subagents; each subagent iterates on retrieval, close reading and deduction and returns a sub-report with its reasoning chain; the main agent cross-validates, reviews and **enforces at least two global loops** before deciding to stop. The final report is logic-closed, traceable and low-hallucination.

**When to use** — complex, open-ended questions that need external evidence and logical deduction: industry analysis, market research, competitive analysis, policy interpretation, technology research, trend forecasting. Do not use it for simple Q&A or basic computation.

Removing the bundle unregisters the provider and its skills:

```text
dsh plugin remove dsh-docchain
```

(or `plugin_manager remove_bundle`).

Uninstalling does not clean up what this plugin wrote: `~/.dsh/storages/docchain-config.json` and any `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY__*` entries in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` stay behind and must be removed by hand.

一个知识库和文档转换 DSH 插件，内置文件名/内容/元数据检索、主题查询、文档批量上传、文档转 Markdown 解析、多子智能体深度研究工作流，以及知识图谱（Neo4j）能力：查本体结构、执行只读 Cypher、增删改图谱节点/关系，全部走 DocChain API（无需 Neo4j 密码）。任意机器上用 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 安装即可生效，无需手动拷贝到 `~/.agents/skills`。

它的配置页不止一个服务地址：可以保存一组**常用环境**（每个环境有自己的地址与凭据）并一键切换，还能按环境预选**主题**，之后直接说"在这个主题里搜"而不必报 id。

除 `deep-research-advanced`（纯指令工作流，无脚本）外，其余能力都以**原生工具**提供，由宿主进程内直接执行（不再经由 shell 跑脚本）：

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `docchain_doc_search` | 按 doc_id / 文档名称定位文档，列出详情，可选读取正文（分段续读） |
| `docchain_content_search` | 在文档正文中按关键词搜索，返回命中行号与内容 |
| `docchain_filename_search` | 在指定主题内按文件名关键词查找文档 |
| `docchain_topic_info` | 查询主题列表，支持分页与名称/ID 关键字过滤 |
| `docchain_meta_search` | 按自定义元数据字段筛选文档（字符串/数值/时间，AND / OR 组） |
| `docchain_upload` | 把文件或文件夹（仅顶层）批量上传到指定主题 |
| `docchain_image_search` | 图搜图：用本地图片检索相似图片 |
| `docchain_image_describe` | 文档图片转文字：逐张生成中文描述（流程图改出 PlantUML 草图）并写成旁路描述 md |
| `doc2markdown` | 把 docx/doc/pdf/pptx/xlsx/图片等解析为 Markdown |
| `docchain_kg_schema` | 查主题本体结构（实体类型含属性 + 关系类型），走 DocChain API |
| `docchain_kg_cypher` | 在主题知识图谱执行只读 Cypher，走 DocChain API |
| `docchain_kg_upsert_node` | 新增/编辑本体或实体节点，走 DocChain API |
| `docchain_kg_upsert_relation` | 新增本体或实体关系，走 DocChain API |
| `docchain_kg_delete_node` | 删除节点（连带其关系），走 DocChain API |
| `docchain_kg_delete_relation` | 删除关系，走 DocChain API |

| 技能 | 形态 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `docchain-filename-search` | SKILL.md + Node.js 脚本 | 在指定主题内按文件名关键词查找文档（工具 `docchain_filename_search`） |
| `docchain-doc-search` | SKILL.md + Node.js 脚本 | 按 doc_id 或文档名称关键字定位文档、列出详情，并可读取指定文档正文（分段续读；工具 `docchain_doc_search`） |
| `docchain-content-search` | SKILL.md + Node.js 脚本 | 在文档内容中搜索关键词，返回行号和内容，支持"或/且"（工具 `docchain_content_search`） |
| `docchain-meta-search` | SKILL.md + Node.js 脚本 | 按自定义元数据字段查询文档（字符串/数值/时间，精确与范围；工具 `docchain_meta_search`） |
| `docchain-topic-info` | SKILL.md + Node.js 脚本 | 查询 docchain 主题列表，支持分页与名称/ID 关键字过滤（工具 `docchain_topic_info`） |
| `docchain-upload` | SKILL.md + Node.js 脚本 | 把本地文件或整个文件夹批量上传到指定 docchain 主题（工具 `docchain_upload`） |
| `doc2markdown` | SKILL.md + Node.js 脚本 | 把 docx/doc/pdf/pptx/xlsx/图片等常见格式解析为 Markdown（工具 `doc2markdown`） |
| `docchain-image-search` | SKILL.md + Node.js 脚本 | 图搜图：给一张图，找库里相似的图片（工具 `docchain_image_search`） |
| `docchain-image-describe` | SKILL.md + Node.js 脚本 | 文档图片转文字：逐张图片生成中文描述（流程图/架构图改出 PlantUML 草图）并写成旁路描述 md，主 md 不动（工具 `docchain_image_describe`） |
| `deep-research-advanced` | 仅 SKILL.md | 主控式多子智能体深度研究工作流（纯指令，无脚本、无工具） |
| `docchain-kg` | 仅 SKILL.md | DocChain 知识图谱：查本体/执行 Cypher/写操作，全部走 DocChain A

同一个包装进哪个 profile，取决于你如何运行 DSH：

| 运行方式 | 命令 |
|---|---|
| 桌面版 | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wct-lab/dsh-docchain` |
| `dsh web` | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:wct-lab/dsh-docchain` |

装完重启 DSH，让宿主半区与客户端半区重新加载。或从本地目录安装：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target=<本目录绝对路径>
```

包内不携带任何凭据。除 `doc2markdown` 外的每个脚本（Node.js）运行前都需要 docchain 服务地址与 API Key；`doc2markdown`（Node.js）两者都不需要——使用内置默认地址并匿名上传，同样可用上述配置链指向其他地址/Key。

| 配置项 | 说明 | 必填 |
|---|---|---|
| `docchain_url` | docchain 服务地址，如 `http://<host>:7100/llmdoc` | 是 |
| `docchain_api_key` | API 认证密钥 | 是 |

四种配置方式，按**优先级**从高到低：

1. 环境变量 `DOCCHAIN_URL`、`DOCCHAIN_API_KEY`；
2. 技能目录下的配置文件 `<skill>/scripts/config.json`；
3. 插件状态文件 `~/.dsh/storages/docchain-config.json`（插件配置写入，见下）；
4. 包内 `skills/docchain_config.json`（文件分发兜底；包内只带模板 `docchain_config.example.json`）。

环境变量优先级最高，高于其下所有来源，也包括插件配置页上选中的环境——见 [多环境切换](#多环境切换)。

配置文件格式（均为 JSON）：

```json
{
  "docchain_url": "http://<host>:7100/llmdoc",
  "docchain_api_key": "your-api-key-here"
}

所有脚本均仅需 Node.js，在技能根目录下以 `node scripts/<脚本>.js …` 方式运行（参数见各 SKILL.md）。

插件自带 Web 客户端的**配置页**：在 `dsh web` 中打开侧栏的「插件」，找到 `dsh-docchain` 插件，点击其行上的配置控件即可打开。页面管理的是一组环境；地址与 Key 都是环境的属性，在该环境行内录入与编辑，没有独立的顶层输入框。Key 本身写入凭据存储，只写不读：页面不会回显已保存的值，只提示是否已配置。

插件遵循官方凭据模式，Config schema 包含：

| 字段 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `docchain_url` | 没有生效环境时使用的服务地址；volatile 字段，由页面与生效环境保持同步 |
| `docchain_api_key_ref` | API Key 的凭据引用名，默认 `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY` |
| `docchain_api_key` | 备用：直接写死 Key（不推荐；凭据存储优先） |
| `docchain_environments` | 常用环境列表（JSON）：每个环境的名称、地址、凭据引用名以及预选主题；生效环境优先于 `docchain_url` |
| `neo4j_uri` | Neo4j 连接地址（Bolt），如 `neo4j://<host>:17687`；保留供将来直连工具复用（当前无工具使用） |
| `neo4j_user` | Neo4j 用户名，默认 `neo4j` |
| `neo4j_password` | Neo4j 密码；保留供将来直连工具复用（当前图谱工具全部走 API，无需此字段） |
| `neo4j_database` | Neo4j 数据库名，默认 `neo4j` |

Key 的实际值保存在**凭据存储** `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`（`refs:` 段，仅本用户可读）——可通过配置页写入或直接编辑文件，改动热生效；也可以用同名启动环境变量提供。激活时、存储凭据变化时、以及本行设置保存时，解析出的值会被镜像写入 `~/.dsh/storages/docchain-config.json`（权限 `0600`）：该文件是当前解析结果的纯投影，配置清空后对应条目随之消失；脚本每次运行读取该文件。

Key 解析顺序：凭据存储（启动环境 > 存储文件）> `docchain_api_key` 行内字面值。

引用名本身就是配置：**让 `docchain_api_key_ref` 保持未配置是受支持的状态，不是故障。** 页面会显示「未配置」，脚本以「配置不完整」退出，而不会回落到别的引用——一把「存在但不对」的 key 会静默查到错误的账号，比直接报错难发现得多。

修改配置的方式：

- 使用插件页上的**配置页**——新增或编辑一个环境（含地址与 Key）；或
- 在凭据存储中保存/更新 `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY`——无需触碰本插件即生效；或
- 直接编辑 `~/.dsh/storages/docchain-config.json`（下一次脚本运行即生效；插件在激活或配置变化时会按解析结果重写该文件，需要长期覆盖请用环境变量或技能级 config.json）；或
- 在插件 config 行（patch `config` / preset override）设置 `docchain_url` / `docchain_api_key_ref` / `docchain_api_key` 后重新激活插件。

配置页可以保存一组**常用环境**，换 docchain 服务时不必再重输地址与 Key。

- 页面顶部只显示当前生效的环境；点开展开列表，可切换、新增、编辑、删除。
- 点选即生效——不用按保存、不用重启。
- 每个环境各自保存地址与独立的凭据引用，所以切回去不需要重新输入 Key。Key 始终存在凭据存储里，只写不读。
- 页面只管理环境：地址与 Key 都是环境的属性，在该行内编辑，没有独立的输入框要同步。一个环境都没保存时行内显示「未选择环境」，此时仍以旧的 `docchain_url` / `docchain_api_key_ref` 配置兜底（可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里改）。
- 删除环境会连带删除它的凭据——除非还有别的环境共用同一引用，或它就是本行自己的兜底引用。正在生效的环境不能删除，需先切走。

数据存放位置：

| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 环境列表（名称、地址、凭据引用名、预选主题） | profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中 `config.docchain_environments` |
| 各环境的 Key | `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 段，键名形如 `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY__<ID>` |
| 当前生效值——地址、Key，以及生效环境选中的主题 `docchain_topic_ids` / `docchain_topic_names` | `~/.dsh/storages/docchain-config.json`，每次切换重写 |

两个需要知道的限制：

- **环境变量优先。** 每个技能脚本都先读 `DOCCHAIN_URL` / `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY`，再读投影文件，所以启动时导出的变量会静默压过页面上的选择。想让页面说了算，就不要设置它们。
- 两个标签页同时改同一行：后保存者覆盖。

每个环境还可以预先选择最多 **10 个主题**，之后直接说"在这个主题里搜"即可，不必再报 ID。

- 主题列表来自当前环境：一个关键词框，服务端**同时按 topic_id 与主题名称**匹配（子串、大小写不敏感，输入完整 id 或完整名称即可收窄到一条）+ 分页；每行显示 `topic_id` 与名称。
- 浏览器拿不到 API Key，所以页面请求宿主的同源路由 `GET /plugin/dsh-docchain/topics`，由宿主代查服务。
- 选择按环境保存（存在该环境的 `topics` 里），切换环境时主题随之切换。
- 只要选了至少一个主题，宿主会把「当前环境 + 这些 topic_id」注入 agent 上下文；用户说"当前主题"或未指定 `topic_ids` 时使用它。一个都没选则不注入。
- 服务地址必须是接口地址，不能是浏览器登录页：`/login?redirect=…` 这类地址会让主题列表加载失败（列表里会标 ⚠）。
两个限制：服务端删掉的主题不会从选择里自动移除（存的是名称快照，之后用它必然失败）；该路由对本机任何能访问该端口的进程可见——它只返回当前环境的主题名称，不含任何凭据。
Bundle 插入一个 Host 插件（`dsh-docchain`），激活时在 `ctx.skills` 上注册技能提供者，服务本包 `<skills>/<name>/SKILL.md` 下的每个技能目录：

- 目录条目来自各 SKILL.md 的 frontmatter（`name`、`description`）；每次加载都重新读文件。
- 提供者 rank 为 **450**：项目根（`.dsh/skills` = 100、项目 `.agents/skills` = 200）、runtime 注册（250）与 `customSkillDirs`（300）优先级更高，`~/.dsh/skills`（400）同样优先；本 Bundle 高于 `~/.agents/skills`（500）与 bundled 根（600）。也就是说：`~/.agents/skills` 里的同名旧副本会被本 Bundle 覆盖；确认无误后可删除旧副本，只保留单一来源。
- 配置页依赖两个可选服务：宿主在 Web 服务器上注册 `GET /plugin/dsh-docchain/topics`（浏览器拿不到 API Key，由宿主代当前环境查询），以及一段描述「当前环境 + 已选主题」的 prompt section。缺少这两个服务的部署仍然拥有技能提供者与投影文件。
- 这两者都不缓存业务状态：每次调用都读实时行配置，所以切换环境或主题后，脚本与下一步模型都能立刻看到，无需重启。

| 工具 | 参数要点 |
|---|---|
| `docchain_doc_search` | `doc_ids` 或 `keyword` 二选一；`content: true` 读正文（限 1 个 id）；`offset` / `max_lines` 分段续读 |
| `docchain_content_search` | `keywords` 必填；`doc_ids` / `topic_ids` 至少一个；`operator` 取 `or`/`and` |
| `docchain_filename_search` | `keywords` + `topic_ids` 均必填（只在该主题范围内按文件名查） |
| `docchain_topic_info` | `page` / `size` / `keyword` 都可选 |
| `docchain_meta_search` | `conditions` 为 `[{field, op, value}]`（AND）、`or_groups` 组内 OR 组间 AND；`list_fields: true` 列字段 |
| `docchain_upload` | `path` + `topic_id` 必填；`mode` 取 `file`/`folder`（仅顶层） |
| `docchain_image_search` | `image` 必填；`topic_ids` 省略则用配置页选中主题；`all` 扫全库 |
| `docchain_image_describe` | `doc_ids` 直接处理；只给 `keyword` 时**仅返回候选**；`read` 读回已生成的描述 md；`list_models` 看可用视觉模型；批量 >1 篇需 `confirm` |
| `doc2markdown` | `file_path` 必填；`action` 取 `convert`/`check`；`md_only` 只导出单个 md |
| `docchain_kg_schema` | `topic_id` 必填；`ontology_type` 取 `ontology`/`dg_ontology` |
| `docchain_kg_cypher` | `topic_id` + `cypher` 必填；只读查询（MATCH/CALL/SHOW…RETURN），无 LIMIT 自动补 |
| `docchain_kg_upsert_node` | `topic_id` + `node_type`（`ontology`/`entity`）必填；本体需 `entity_name`，实体需 `ontology_id_list`；`doc_ids` 关联文档 |
| `docchain_kg_upsert_relat

实现上工具与脚本**共用同一份代码**：宿主 `require` 脚本模块后调用其导出的计算函数，所以工具结果与 `node scripts/...` 的输出不会分叉。工具注册走 `ctx.inject(["tools"])`——宿主没有工具服务时，技能、投影文件与配置页照常工作，只是没有这些工具。

工具失败时返回 `{ ok: false, error, message }`，`error` 取值与脚本一致：`CONFIG` / `NO_RESULTS` / `NOT_FOUND` / `NO_PERMISSION` / `SERVER_ERROR`（`doc2markdown` 另有 `PENDING`，表示仍在转换、用 `check` 继续）。参数一律用数组或对象（`doc_ids: [1, 2]`），不再拼逗号字符串。

`docchain_upload`、`docchain_image_describe` 与 `doc2markdown` 的 `convert` 标记为**不可并发**（前者写知识库、中间那个是长任务、后者是长流程）；其余检索类工具可并发。

readme.section: docchain-filename-search（在指定主题内按文件名搜索）
readme.text:
在**指定主题范围内**按文件名关键词定位文档。

**交互方式**：描述要查找的文件名关键词，**必须指定主题 ID**（本技能只在这些主题里找）。

> 与 `docchain-doc-search` 的分工：若要**跨全部主题**按文件名查找，或用 doc_id 定位、读文档正文，请用 `docchain-doc-search`；本技能是"限定主题 + 只按文件名"。

**示例**：

- "帮我在主题112中找文档名包含'合同'的文件"
- "在主题1,10里搜索'采购'或'协议'的文档"

readme.section: docchain-doc-search（按文档 ID / 文档名称定位并读正文）
readme.text:
按 doc_id 或文档名称关键字找到"是哪个文档"，列出详情（名称、所属主题、页数、大小、状态）；需要时可读取指定文档的正文（分段返回，用 `next_offset` 续读）。用于"这个 id 是哪份文档""名字带 XX 的文档有哪些""把某份文档的正文读出来"。

**交互方式**：给出一个或多个文档 ID，或一个文档名称关键字（`--keyword` 为全库跨主题搜索）；要读正文时指定单个文档 ID 加 `--content`。

> 与 `docchain-filename-search` 的区别：本技能按文件名全库搜、且能按 doc_id 查详情与读正文；只想在某个主题内按文件名找，用 `docchain-filename-search`。与 `docchain-content-search` 的区别：本技能按 doc_id / 文档名找文档本身，不是在正文里搜关键词。

**示例**：

- "查一下文档 125672 是什么"
- "125672 和 125755 分别是哪两份文档"
- "找一下名字带'评价标准'的文档"
- "把文档 125755 的开头读出来"

在文档内容中搜索关键词，返回匹配行的行号和内容，支持"或/且"两种操作符。

**交互方式**：指定搜索范围和关键词。必须提供 `doc_ids` 和 `topic_ids` 至少其一。

**示例**：

- "在文档123里搜索'合同'"
- "在主题1,2里搜索同时包含'API'和'接口'的内容"

通过自定义元数据字段条件筛选文档，支持字符串、数值、时间类型的精确匹配与范围查询。

**交互方式**：描述筛选条件。必须指定主题 ID 或文档 ID。

**示例**：

- "在主题112中查找元数据中作者是张三的文档"
- "在主题113中查找金额字段大于1000的合同"

查询 docchain 系统中的主题列表，支持分页浏览与按名称关键字过滤。常作为其他技能的前置步骤：先拿到主题 ID，再按主题检索或上传。

**交互方式**：直接询问有哪些主题，可带页码、每页数量或名称关键字。

**示例**：

- "有哪些主题"
- "看下主题列表第 2 页，每页 10 条"
- "按关键字 test 过滤主题名称"

把本地单个文件或整个文件夹批量上传到指定 docchain 主题，逐个上传并显示进度与成功/失败统计。文件夹仅扫描顶层文件（不递归）。

**交互方式**：给出文件/文件夹路径与目标主题 ID（`--topic_id` 必填）。

**示例**：

- "把 ./report.pdf 上传到主题 123"
- "把 ./docs 文件夹里的文档批量上传到主题 456"

把文档（docx、doc、pdf、ppt、xlsx、图片、epub、mobi 等常见格式）上传到 docchain 解析服务，转换结果下载到源文件同目录——可以是单个 `.md` 文件（`--md`）或含图片、表格的完整 MD 包。

**交互方式**：给出文件路径，如"读一下 ./report.pdf 的内容"或"把 合同.docx 转成 Markdown"。

**示例**：

- "总结 /path/to/report.pdf 的内容"
- "把 合同.docx 转成单个 Markdown 文件"

服务地址与 API Key 沿用检索脚本同一配置链，但均为可选：不配置时使用内置默认服务地址（`https://lab.hjcloud.com/llmdoc`）匿名上传。

把一张本地图片上传到当前环境，返回库里相似的图片——**图片本身**，以及它所属的主题（id 与名称）、文档名和相似度。命中的图片会下载到临时目录，便于在对话里展示。

**用法** — 发一张照片或截图然后提问。docchain 接口没有全局图片搜索，所以检索按主题进行：默认用配置页选中的主题，也可 `--topic_ids` 指定，或用 `--all` 扫描全部主题。

- "这张截图是哪个文档里的？"
- "帮我找类似的图片"

需要注意：

- `score` 是服务端的**视觉相似度**（0–1，原图检索原图 = 1），**不是助手的判断**；请把它当作排序依据，而不是绝对值——低分不等于无关；
- 能否搜到**按主题**区分：图片向量是一个主题一个主题建立的，没做过向量化的主题对任何查询都返回空（实测：同一实例上有向量的主题能命中、没有的恒为空）。脚本会把这种情况说明白，而不是让你以为库里没有；
- 个别图片会让服务端返回 HTTP 500（那张图处理不了），脚本会按主题记录并如实提示，不会静默失败；
- `--all` 会遍历全部主题，慢且请求量大（数千次查询）。知道主题时优先用选中的主题。

把文档里的图片转成文字：读文档主 md → 逐张图片交给多模态模型 → 普通图片在图片上方插入 `<!-- image-desc: … -->` 中文描述 → 写成该文档的**旁路描述 md**。

**流程图/架构图这类结构图走另一条路**：模型只回答「节点 + 边」的数据，由脚本按固定模板渲染成一段 `plantuml` 草图，放在本该是描述的位置。模型不写 PlantUML 语法（语法由脚本生成，所以一定合法）；照片、界面截图、曲线图、表格仍然写中文描述。

**主 md 一字不动**：描述存在独立文件里，用 `GET /v1/doc/read?doc_id=<id>&read_format=image_description_md` 读回。因此普通阅读行为不受影响，chat-agent 需要图片语义时才读这份旁路文件。

**用法**：

- "把 125755 里的图片都转成文字"
- "帮我搜名字带'大语言模型'的文档，我自己选"（只给 `keyword`，**只返回候选清单**，不处理）
- "125755 的图片描述生成好了吗？"（`read: true`）
- "这台机器能用哪些视觉模型？"（`list_models: true`）

需要注意：

- **时间**：描述按"信息密度"生成（平均约 350–400 字符），单张约 8–12 秒。结构图那张要**3 次调用**（分类 + 主读 + 复核），约 25–50 秒；描述图 **2 次**（分类 + 描述）。9 张图实测 1–4 分钟（网关波动大）。默认一次处理完整篇；`max_images` 只在确实想控成本时用——它判断不出描述质量，拆成两轮还会让用户重复选一次视觉模型；
- **先分类再执行**：每张图先单独问一次「该出结构还是该写描述」，只让它回答一个词。判据是"图里的**连接线**是否承载信息"：有连线、且去掉连线关系就没了 → 结构；靠色块/分栏/竖排标注表达的版式信息图、方框之间没有连线的并列表 → 描述（哪怕看起来有很多方框）。结果里 `diagram.structured` / `diagram.as_prose` 是两个分类计数，`diagram.suspect` 是"判成描述但回答里又出现图数据"、被补问过一次的张数，`diagram.annotation_guard` 是"判成结构但节点多是版面标注"、被兜底退回描述的张数；
- **产物形态（两种图统一）**：结构图 → 一段 `plantuml` 代码块；其它图 → 一段中文描述注释。**无论哪种，原图都不再嵌进正文**，统一改成一行 `[原图](地址)` 链接，需要对照时点开；
- **可疑复核**：判成"描述"、但那次回答里出现了图数据签名 `"nodes":` 时，会补问一次结构提示词，能出图就改判为图；平时刻意不做，避免每张都多花一次调用。实测两篇文档 14 张图里触发 0 次；
- **两遍读图**：结构图用主模型读一遍、复核模型再读一遍。第二遍做两件事：① 只删两家**方向相反**的边（其余保留）；② 比对节点集，把「复核有、主模型没有」的数量报成 `diagram.missing_from_primary`（**只告警不补图** —— 复核也可能幻觉出不存在的部门，补进去等于制造新错误）。`docchain_vision_judge_model` 传空串可关掉，省一半调用；
- **规模**：单张最多 **80 节点 / 140 条边**；渲染后超过 **6000 字符**才会裁剪。这三条只是"防爆"兜底——**正常组织架构图（40~60 个方框）不会再被裁**。理由：产物是给对话助手读的代码，删一个节点助手就永远不知道那个部门存在（实测 41 节点的组织图曾被裁到 24 个，13 个团队在产物里一个字不剩）。万一仍触发裁剪，被裁数记在 `diagram.trimmed` 并出 `DIAGRAM_TRIMMED` 警告；
- **推断边画虚线**：图上编号（`1`、`2` 这类）会被当噪声丢掉，为免主干断开，丢弃节点的前驱会直连其后继——**这条线原图并不存

**视觉模型配置**：读图用的模型**跟随你在对话里选的那个**，工具没有 `model` 参数，没有任何东西能悄悄替换它。当前对话模型读不了图时，工具会暂停并让你从网关清单里点选一个视觉模型，**选择只对本次调用生效，不改你的对话模型**。下面的字段是"取不到对话模型"时的兜底。默认 `https://lab.iwhalecloud.com/gpt-proxy/v1`，Key 取凭据库的 `IWHALE_API_KEY`。要换地址/长度上限，改这几个字段（配置页不渲染输入框，改设置文档即可）：

```yaml
docchain_vision_url: https://lab.iwhalecloud.com/gpt-proxy/v1
docchain_vision_model: doubao-seed-2.0-pro         # 兜底：取不到对话模型时才用
docchain_vision_candidates: doubao-seed-2.0-pro,g-doubao-seed-2.1-pro,qwen3-vl-plus,glm-5v-turbo,g-gpt-5.6-sol
                                                  # 逗号分隔，最好在前。顺序来自实测横评

CLI 用环境变量：`VISION_BASE_URL` / `VISION_MODEL` / `VISION_JUDGE_MODEL` / `VISION_FALLBACK_MODEL` / `VISION_API_KEY` / `VISION_MAX_DESC_CHARS` / `VISION_DIAGRAM`。用 `list_models` 可以先看这把 key 到底能用哪些视觉模型。

**接自己的模型服务**：`docchain_vision_url` + `docchain_vision_key_ref` 改指自己的 OpenAI 兼容网关即可（豆包方舟、通义百炼、自建 vLLM 都行）。模型清单会**自动适应用户的网关**：

- 网关返回 `is_vision` 字段 → 以字段为准；
- 没有该字段（豆包官方、阿里、OpenAI 的 `/v1/models` 都只有 id）→ 按模型名识别（`vision` / `vl` / `gpt-4o` / `doubao-2.x` 等）；
- 内置候选名在你的网关上**一个都不存在**时，按你网关自己的顺序列出，而不是列一堆用不了的。

**拿不到任何视觉模型时**（例如当前用的是 DeepSeek 账号，它只有纯文本模型），工具**不会弹窗列模型**，而是直接提示：

> 当前没有可使用的视觉模型，请更换 API key 选择可使用的视觉模型。

这样不会让用户白点一次再撞墙。

面向 ReAct 单智能体的主控式多子智能体深度研究工作流（纯指令，无脚本）：主智能体试探摸底、拆分独立任务并行下发；子智能体自主迭代检索、精读、推导，输出带推导链路的子报告；主智能体汇总交叉推演、复盘深化，**强制保底 2 轮全局循环**后自主判定终止。最终生成逻辑闭环、推导清晰、低幻觉、可溯源的研究报告。

**适用场景**：复杂、开放性、需外部资料佐证、需逻辑推演的研究问题——行业分析、市场调研、竞品剖析、政策解读、技术调研、趋势预测。简单问答、闲聊、基础计算禁止使用。

移除 Bundle 后，提供者与技能一并注销：

```text
dsh plugin remove dsh-docchain
```

（或 `plugin_manager remove_bundle`）。

卸载不会清理本插件写下的内容：`~/.dsh/storages/docchain-config.json` 与 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 中的 `DOCCHAIN_API_KEY__*` 条目会保留，需要手动删除。
